rules: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all headings and metrics/numbers in the dashboard.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text, data tables, and input fields.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for barcode data and SKU numbers to ensure exact alignment.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Labels over inputs and tables must be uppercase with wide tracking.

colors.description: A fabric/textile-inspired enterprise palette. 'Deep Denim' blue acts as the primary structure color, conveying trust and inventory management solidity. The background is a 'Raw Cotton' warm off-white, preventing the clinical feel of pure white. Accents use 'Terracotta' and 'Sage Green' for status indicators (overdue, issued, returned).

layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous Tailwind spacing: p-6 for default cards, p-8 for major layout sections.
layout_spacing.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-border). No soft drop-shadows. Use strict geometric shapes to emulate an enterprise ERP feel, avoiding heavy glassmorphism.

components.buttons: Flat, unshadowed. Primary buttons use Deep Denim (bg-primary text-primary-foreground) with slight hover opacity reduction. Use data-testid attributes for all.
components.tables: Dense, data-heavy design. Use 'SaaSFrame' patterns: sticky headers, horizontal scrolling for overflow, subtle 1px border between rows. Row height: condensed (40px) or standard (48px). Incorporate inline action menus (Shadcn DropdownMenu) at the end of rows.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic where possible, or strictly flat cards with 1px border. Internal padding must be p-6. For metric cards, put the value in Cabinet Grotesk font-black.
components.forms: Use Shadcn inputs, selects, and textareas. Labels must be uppercase 'label' typography. Use grid layouts for multi-field forms (e.g., Add Catalog).
components.badges: Use rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. Statuses: Available (Sage Green), Issued (Blue), Overdue/Damaged (Terracotta).
components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (w-64) with dense, hierarchical navigation. Active states get a left border highlight (border-l-4 border-primary bg-muted/50).

motion.transitions: Keep animations minimal. Use smooth hover state transitions (transition-colors duration-200). Use subtle stagger for dashboard cards on load.

icons.style: Use 'regular' weight for UI, 'duotone' for large dashboard metric icons.

backgrounds.description: White textile background for auth pages

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Tailwind config is updated with the custom colors provided.
Do not use generic 'blue-500' or 'gray-100'. Use the HSL CSS variables from the color palette.
Implement Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans fonts via CDN or standard imports.
Build the dashboard using a dense, enterprise SaaS grid. Avoid excessive white space in tables.
For the Barcode & QR Code pages, use a monospace font (JetBrains Mono) for the printed codes to ensure technical accuracy and aesthetic fit.
The UI should feel sharp (no rounded corners beyond rounded-sm) to match the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' structure.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-catalog-button').
Replace Shadcn's default 'Vercel-look' borders with crisp 1px solid borders.
Use Phosphor Icons for all navigational and UI iconography.
Implement dark mode correctly, ensuring contrast ratios remain accessible.
